@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9c80
+title: Dedupe PromptCache.swift's repeated cache-rebuild return pattern across resolve/applyDecision paths
+---
+## What
+Surfaced by review pressure on `mej3zgh`'s chunk-store commit, but confirmed genuinely pre-existing via `git diff 00738c1..HEAD` — zero matches, untouched by any commit in the mej3zgh/wx4w28j chunk-store work. This is older debt in the original multi-slot LCP cache mechanism (`resolve()`/`applyDecision`/`decide`).
+
+`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/PromptCache.swift`: the "rebuild cache from scratch" pattern `(model.newCache(parameters: parameters), newTokens)` (or its `SendableBox`-wrapped form) is repeated verbatim across (at time of finding) lines ~228, ~263, ~277, ~298 — 4 separate return sites in `resolve()`'s switch-based decision handling. Additionally a near-duplicate `return (slot.cache, Array(newTokens.suffix(count)))`-shaped return appears at ~249/~265 differing only in a local variable name.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Extract a shared helper (e.g. `private func rebuildResult() -> (cache: [KVCache], tokensToFeed: [Int])` returning `(model.newCache(parameters: parameters), newTokens)`) and use it at all rebuild-from-scratch return sites.
+- [ ] Consider unifying or extracting the near-duplicate `(slot.cache, Array(newTokens.suffix(count)))`-shaped returns similarly.
+- [ ] No behavior change — pure refactor.
+- [ ] Build clean, full `PromptCache`/`MLXFoundationModelsTests` suite green.
+- [ ] A local review pass (`review sha` scoped to the commit) confirms zero remaining findings of this class.
+
+## Scope
+`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/PromptCache.swift` only. Not urgent/blocking — pre-existing cleanliness debt in the original slot-based cache mechanism, not a correctness bug. Line numbers will have shifted since this task was written — relocate by content, not number.
\ No newline at end of file
